hero.lede: Deploy containerized AI agents on Kubernetes, manage their runtime and talk to them in real time — from one RANCH interface.
hero.no_agent_title: No public agent on this page yet
hero.no_agent_lede: This page only previews public agents that allow {origin}. An owner sets both for an agent in the admin console.

stage.needs_agent: Available once a public agent is deployed
stage.life_pending: Record created, waiting for a cluster slot
stage.life_deploying: Argo Workflow is scheduling the pod
stage.life_running: Pod ready, agent connected to the hub
stage.runtime_live_note: The status shown is this agent's current phase.
stage.runtime_demo_note: Demo: the phases cycle to show the lifecycle Ranch tracks.
stage.flow_online: Agent online in the Bridle hub
stage.workflow_note: Demo: the steps advance on a timer, not on a backend event.

steps.title: From configuration to a running agent.
steps.lede: Three steps for the user; the cluster, the workflow and the sockets are Ranch's job.
steps.configure_body: Pick an agent template, set CPU and memory, decide whether the agent is public.
steps.deploy_body: Ranch submits an Argo Workflow to the cluster. The phase comes back to the console as it changes.
steps.interact_body: The agent connects to the Bridle hub. Open the chat, send a message, watch the streamed reply.
steps.ui_msg_agent: Three restarts, one image pull retry, no errors since 14:20.

capabilities.title: Everything an agent needs between the image and the conversation.
capabilities.lede: What the console does in its current version.
capabilities.chat_body: Every running agent is reachable through the Socket.IO gateway with JWT authorization and streamed replies. Thinking blocks, attachments and sources arrive as they are produced.
capabilities.chat_msg_agent: Two: agent-7f2c at 02:14 after an image update, agent-a913 at 05:40 on a memory limit.
capabilities.templates_body: Choose a Docker image, set CPU and memory — a template fixes the defaults, you adjust them per agent.
capabilities.lifecycle_body: Pending, deploying, running, failed, stopped — Ranch follows the workflow phase and shows it in the interface. Restart, stop and start are one action each.
capabilities.workflow_body: Each deployment is an Argo Workflow in your k3s cluster. Cancel it, change the image tag, resubmit — the agent record stays.
capabilities.logs_body: Read the agent's logs from the pod without leaving the console. Pod metrics come from the same place.
capabilities.fleet_body: Several agents per install, an admin console for templates, users, quotas and the whole fleet in the cluster.

runtime.title: The infrastructure that works behind the scenes.
runtime.lede: What happens between pressing Deploy and the first reply.
runtime.config_body: Template, image tag, resources, visibility. Stored as the agent record the console shows.
runtime.argo_body: Ranch submits a workflow; its phase — Pending, Running, Succeeded — becomes the agent status.
runtime.k8s_body: The workflow schedules a pod on k3s with the requested CPU and memory. Logs and metrics are read from it.
runtime.agent_body: The container joins the Bridle hub. From here on it answers over Socket.IO with JWT-protected channels.
runtime.note: The status in the console comes from the workflow phase and the pod state.

final.title: Your next agent starts here.
final.lede: Configure, deploy and run your AI agent with RANCH.
